versions.content: The content of EcucModuleConfigurationValues is splitable among several XML-Files The EcucModuleConfigurationValues aggregates the EcucContainerValue with the role container and the stereotype atpSplitable which allows the content of a EcucModuleConfigurationVa- lues to be split among several XML-Files.
